summary: ASTROCARE is a browser-based educational prototype designed to demonstrate astronaut health monitoring. It displays sample health readings, health trends, demonstration alerts, and radiation exposure records in one dashboard. It also provides observation history and CSV report export. The system aims to demonstrate how health information could be organized for long-duration space missions.
details: ASTROCARE is a browser-based educational prototype designed to demonstrate astronaut health monitoring during long-duration space missions. It combines simulated health readings, trend visualization, rule-based demonstration alerts, and mission exposure records in one dashboard. The system displays sample heart rate, blood oxygen level, body temperature, blood pressure, and illustrative radiation exposure information. It also includes an astronaut profile, observation history, Start, Pause, Test Alert, and Reset controls, and CSV report export. The prototype was developed using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and the Canvas API. NASA Human Research Program resources about the five hazards and risks of human spaceflight informed the project background and design context. All changing readings are simulated sample data and are not connected to real medical sensors, spacecraft, or NASA systems. This is an educational prototype, not a medical device. ChatGPT was used to assist with code development and project text.
